description: This file defines a flexible, unsafe union class (AUnion) supporting non-POD types, and a container class (AData) for storing arbitrary types with strict or relaxed type safety, including support for custom flaggers, move/copy semantics, and type management. It is part of the Android media foundation, providing type-erased storage with safety wrappers.

classes.name: _AUnion_impl
classes.description: Helper class for constructing and destructing objects within the unsafe union storage.

classes.name: AUnion
classes.description: Templated unsafe union supporting multiple types with manual construction/destruction.

classes.name: _AData_copier
classes.description: Utility class for copying objects, specialized for copy-assignable and copy-constructible types.

classes.name: _AData_mover
classes.description: Utility class for moving objects, specialized for move-assignable and move-constructible types.

classes.name: _AData_deleter
classes.description: Template for deleting stored objects of specific types within AUnion.

classes.name: _AData_copy_assigner
classes.description: Template for copying-assigning objects of specific types within AUnion.

classes.name: _AData_move_assigner
classes.description: Template for move-assigning objects of specific types within AUnion.

classes.name: AData
classes.description: Container class supporting storage of multiple types with strict or relaxed type safety, including custom flaggers, move/copy semantics, and type management.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Constructs an object of type T in the union storage with given arguments.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Destructs an object of type T in the union storage.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a reference to the stored object of type T.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Copies or moves an object of type T to a destination.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Deletes the stored object of a specific type.
